Instructor.role: You are directing a scripted exercise for the command seats.
Instructor.goal: Introduce communication friction and observe how each seat responds.
Instructor.rightNow: The map shows the exercise picture. Trainees see only their own reports.
Instructor.nextStep: Start the exercise, then play Jam Net and Spoof Contact when ready.
Instructor.why: The exercise makes uncertainty visible so a team can discuss how it decides with incomplete information.

T1.role: You are T1, the company commander. You hold the reserve.
T1.goal: Decide where to commit the reserve without a complete picture.
T1.rightNow: Reports may arrive late, incomplete, or in conflict.
T1.nextStep: Review the reports, choose a decision option, and explain your rationale.
T1.why: The exercise is about making and explaining decisions while information is uncertain.

T2.role: You are T2, a platoon commander reporting observations to T1.
T2.goal: Share clear, timely observations through the available link.
T2.rightNow: This seat should act on its own report stream.
T2.nextStep: Review your reports and prepare a concise SITREP for the team.
T2.why: The team depends on observations moving between seats despite communication friction.
